terms.definition: Application of Bill of Rights protections to states through the Fourteenth Amendment.
A prior judicial decision used to guide later cases.
A demanding judicial test applied to certain classifications or fundamental rights.
A legal requirement that a party show a sufficient stake in a dispute.
Displacement of state law by valid federal law.
An election used to select party nominees or narrow candidates.
An election in which voters choose among nominees for office.
An organization seeking to influence public policy.
Measured attitudes held by members of a population.
Systematic comparison of a problem, alternatives, evidence, tradeoffs, and implementation.
A culminating investigation applying disciplinary knowledge to a public problem.
A person or group affected by or able to influence a decision.
A specific course of action available to decision makers.
A benefit sacrificed or cost accepted when choosing among alternatives.
Government information legally available for public inspection, subject to exemptions.
